annotation.title_clean: Digital Services Act: Improving the functioning of the Single Market — European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 with recommendations to the Commission on the Digital Services Act (2020/2018(INL))
annotation.title_en: Digital Services Act: Improving the functioning of the Single Market — European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 with recommendations to the Commission (2020/2018(INL))
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union C 404/2 (6.10.2021)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament legislative-initiative resolution asking the Commission to propose a Digital Services Act: revising the E-Commerce Directive, harmonised notice-and-action for illegal content, transparency on advertising and algorithms, AI/automated decision-making rights, online marketplace product safety liability, and ex ante rules for gatekeeper platforms. It contains no content on robots or other physical AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a harmonised, legally enforceable notice-and-action mechanism while keeping the E-Commerce Directive's safe-harbour protections and its ban on general monitoring
Consumers should be told when a service uses AI or automated decision-making, with rights to opt out and seek redress, plus algorithmic transparency and audits
Online marketplaces should face product-safety duties and liability for unsafe or illegal products
Ex ante rules for systemic gatekeeper platforms, including interoperability requirements
A hybrid EU and national system for supervision and enforcement
